%1$s dialer mein hai, call button aap dabaiye
Message tayyar hai, send aap dabaiye
Battery %1$d%% hai, charging chal rahi hai
Abhi internet nahi hai. Net aate hi TARGET se poochh kar notification bhej dunga.
Jawab ke liye TARGET app mein sign in kariye
Kaun sa? Number boliye, jaise pehla ya dusra
Phone unlock nahi hua, isliye nahi kiya
Contacts dekhne ki permission chahiye. Settings khol raha hoon.
Is phone par WhatsApp nahi mila
%1$s ki WhatsApp chat khol raha hoon
%1$s ki chat mein message likh diya, Send aap dabaiye
%1$s ko WhatsApp call kar raha hoon
%1$s ki chat khol di, call button aap dabaiye
Music chalane wala app nahi mila
Iske liye TARGET ko screen access (Accessibility) chahiye. Settings khol raha hoon.
Screen par padhne layak kuch nahi mila
Screenshot lekar TARGET ko bhej raha hoon
Screenshot ke liye Android 11 ya naya chahiye
Is screen par kya hai, chhote mein samjhao

Meri phone screen par abhi ye likha hai:
"""
%1$s
"""

%2$s
Iske liye notification access chahiye. Settings khol raha hoon.
%1$s: ek OTP/code wala message (sunne ke liye \"OTP padho\" boliye)
Reply karne layak koi message nahi mila
Call uthane/kaatne ki permission chahiye. Settings khol raha hoon.
Call utha liya, speaker on kar raha hoon
Conversation mode on. Boliye, main sun raha hoon. Band karne ke liye \"bas\" boliye.
Ab dost wale andaaz mein baat karunga
Ab professional andaaz mein jawab dunga
Camera khol raha hoon, photo lijiye
Is photo mein kya hai? Chhote mein batao.
Iske liye Do Not Disturb access chahiye. Settings khol raha hoon.
Brightness badalne ki permission chahiye. Settings khol raha hoon.
Settings khol di. Android apps ko ye switch seedha badalne nahi deta, wahan on/off kar dijiye.
(Thoda aage-peeche ho sakta hai: exact alarm permission Settings mein dijiye.)
Calendar mein \"%1$s\" bhar diya, Save aap dabaiye
\"%1$s\" naam ka routine nahi mila. Settings mein bana sakte hain.
Fingerprint ya screen lock se confirm kariye
Aap kahein tab screen padhna aur tap karna

TARGET sirf tab screen padhta hai ya tap/likhta/scroll karta hai jab aap bolte hain (jaise \"screen padho\", \"Send dabao\", ya WhatsApp message aapke \"haan\" ke baad). Kuch bhi apne aap nahi karta, kuch store nahi karta. Screen ka text sirf aapke kehne par TARGET chat mein jaata hai.
✅ TARGET aapka default assistant hai. Power ya home button long-press karke bulaiye.
TARGET abhi default assistant nahi hai.
Bolkar command dene ke liye mic permission chahiye.

Agar dialog nahi aaya: Settings → Apps → Default apps → Digital assistant app → TARGET chuniye. Quick Settings mein \"TARGET bolo\" tile bhi add kar sakte hain. Call, SMS, WhatsApp, reply aur call uthana/kaatna hamesha aapke \"haan\" ke baad hi hota hai (jab tak aap \"bina pooche\" on na karein).
Namaste, main %1$s hoon. Kya madad karun?
Jawab ke baad phir se sunna; \"bas\" ya \"bye\" par band
TARGET bol raha ho tab aap bolein to woh ruk jaaye
Sawal TARGET se poochh kar jawab yahin bolna (aapke TARGET login se)
Aate call ka naam bolna, uthana/kaatna
Neeche wale kaam TARGET hamesha \"haan\" (ya tap) ke baad hi karta hai. Kisi ke liye \"bina pooche\" on karenge to woh seedha ho jaayega.
Har risky kaam se pehle fingerprint ya screen lock. Phone locked ho to hamesha.
Busy ho tab chune hue apps ke naye messages par ek baar (har chat ko 30 minute mein ek baar) aapka message bhejta hai. Default band. Jo bheja, neeche log mein dikhta hai.
Message, kam se kam ek app aur notification access chahiye
Ek naam aur kaam (har line ya comma par ek). Phir boliye: \"subah ka routine chalao\".
Kaam (jaise: torch on, aaj ki news, WhatsApp kholo)
Aapki awaaz sunkar command samajhne ke liye. Sirf tab sunta hai jab aap TARGET kholte hain (ya \"Hey Target\" on karein).
\"Mummy ko call karo\" jaise commands ke liye TARGET aapke contacts mein naam dhoondhta hai, phir aapke \"haan\" ke baad seedha call ya SMS karta hai. Contacts phone se bahar nahi jaate.

Call aane par TARGET caller ka naam bolkar batayega. \"Uthao\" ya \"kaato\" bolne par (aapke \"haan\" ke baad) call utha ya kaat dega. Iske liye phone state, call log (number ke liye) aur call answer permissions chahiye.

Isse TARGET aapke kehne par screen padh sakta hai, button daba sakta hai, likh sakta hai, scroll/back/home/lock/screenshot kar sakta hai, aur WhatsApp mein Send dabaa sakta hai. Apne aap kuch nahi karta. Agli screen par \"TARGET screen helper\" chunkar on kariye.

\"Notifications padho\" par TARGET aapki notifications bolkar sunata hai (OTP wale tab tak nahi jab tak aap na kahein), aapke \"haan\" ke baad reply karta hai, aur aap chahein to busy auto-reply. Agli screen par TARGET ko allow kariye.
Phone silent karne aur DND on/off karne ke liye Android ye access maangta hai. Agli screen par TARGET ko allow kariye.
\"Brightness kam karo\" ke liye TARGET ko system settings badalne ki permission chahiye. Agli screen par allow kariye.
Reminder bilkul sahi minute par aaye, iske liye exact alarm permission chahiye. Bina iske reminder thoda late ho sakta hai.
On karne par TARGET ki chats aur settings kholne se pehle fingerprint, face ya screen lock maangega. 1 minute ke andar wapas aaye to dobara nahi poochhega. Phone mein screen lock set hona chahiye.
Photo TARGET ko bhej raha hoon, dekh ke batata hoon…
Overlay se poochhe sawal aur TARGET ke jawab yahan rehte hain (aakhri 500). Ye phone se bahar nahi jaate; TARGET web app ki chats alag hain.
%1$d sawal internet aane ka intezaar kar rahe hain

App ke andar Google se login abhi kaam nahi karta (Google WebView mein login rokta hai, aur Chrome ka login app tak wapas nahi aata). TARGET mein email/password ya magic link se login kariye. Google login theek karne ke liye web app mein ek naya hand-off step chahiye, woh alag se banega.
Is phone par speech recognition nahi mila
Internet mein dikkat, sun nahi paaya
Naya version aate hi TARGET khud update ho jayega. Android 12+ par bina poochhe, purane phones par ek baar \"Update\" dabana hoga.
Naya version %1$s mila, install ho raha hai…
Install ke liye ek baar \"Update\" dabaiye
Update info nahi mili. Internet check karke dobara try karo.
Download kharab tha (SHA-256 match nahi hua). Thodi der baad phir try hoga.
Naye APK ka signature match nahi hua, isliye update roka gaya.
Ye update aapke Android version par nahi chalega.
